rust/rejected/axmc-os-missing.json.reason: os may be left out in TOML, and a pool without it is a Linux pool

rust/rejected/axpc-axmc-only-fields.json.reason: os is a key a Windows pool defines in TOML, where linux is accepted, so only budget and disk_gb are undefined

shared/rejected/field-name-case.json.reason: TOML keys match in exact case, so a key in the wrong case is unknown and the key it stands for is missing as well

shared/rejected/missing-owner.json.reason: the owner is part of repository in TOML, so a missing owner is reported on repository

shared/rejected/missing-volumes.json.reason: volumes may be left out in TOML, and a pool without it has none
